***[[2025 Saada prison airstrike]]
****The [[Houthi movement|Houthis]] claim at least 68 people are killed and 47 others are injured in a [[United States|U.S.]] [[airstrike]] on a prison holding [[African people|African]] migrants in [[Saada Governorate]], [[Yemen]]. [https://www.politico.com/news/2025/04/28/u-s-fighter-jet-falls-overboard-00314317 (''Politico'')]
*[[Boko Haram insurgency]]
**Sixteen people are killed after the explosion of a [[Improvised explosive device|roadside bomb]] between the towns of [[Rann, Borno|Rann]] and [[Gamboru]] in [[Borno State]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/4/29/roadside-bomb-blast-kills-26-in-nigerias-restive-northeast (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**At least seven people are killed and 16 others are wounded when a bomb explodes outside an anti-[[Pakistani Taliban]] [[peace committee]] office building in [[Wana, Pakistan|Wana]], [[South Waziristan]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-bombing-peace-committee-office-restive-northwest-a8ebb5f3685057b1b1d06bab47d7e72f (AP)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Russia]]n [[President of Russia|president]] [[Vladimir Putin]] declares a three-day [[ceasefire]] in [[Ukraine]] for May 8–10 to mark the [[World War II]] [[Victory Day (9 May)|Victory Day]]. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/russia-ukraine-war/article/putin-declares-3-day-may-ceasefire-to-mark-80-years-since-world-war-two-victory/ (CTV News)]
*[[South Thailand insurgency]]
**Three people are killed and another is severely injured overnight in two separate attacks by suspected [[Islamic terrorism|Islamist insurgent]]s in [[Bannang Sata district]], [[Yala province]], [[Thailand]]. [https://www.nationthailand.com/news/general/40049338 (''The Nation'')]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**Several [[mortar (weapon)|mortars]] from alleged [[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|Al-Shabaab]] militants strike [[Aden Adde Airport]] and Halane Camp, the residences of the [[United Nations Assistance Mission in Somalia|UNSOM]], [[AUSSOM]], and foreign embassies. [https://www.hiiraan.com/news4/2025/Apr/201316/mortar_attack_targets_halane_base_camp_in_mogadishu_casualties_unconfirmed.aspx (''Hiiraan Online'')]

'''Business and economy'''
* [[2025 European power outage]]
** A widespread [[power outage]] is reported in [[Spain]], [[Portugal]], [[Andorra]], and parts of [[France]], shutting down [[airport]]s, [[public transport|public transit]] systems, and many [[hospital]]s. [https://www.lavanguardia.com/vida/20250428/10624908/caida-general-deja-suministro-electrico-toda-espana.html (''La Vanguardia'')] [https://www.elmundo.es/economia/2025/04/28/680f5d2221efa099318b4582.html (''El Mundo'')] [https://www.elconfidencial.com/espana/2025-04-28/directo-cortes-luz-espana-portugal_4117946/ (''El Confidencial'')]
**The [[government of Spain]] declares a national [[state of emergency]] and deploys over 30,000 [[Law enforcement in Spain|police officers]] to maintain order. [[Prime Minister of Portugal|Portuguese prime minister]] [[Luís Montenegro]] rules out a [[cyberattack]] as the cause of the power outage. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/large-parts-spain-portugal-hit-by-power-outage-2025-04-28/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Four female students, ages 4 to 18, are killed and six others are injured when a car crashes through the wall of a [[daycare]] center in [[Chatham, Illinois|Chatham]], [[Illinois]], United States. The driver was not injured but was taken to a hospital for evaluation. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/chatham-illinois-car-crash-daycare-ynot-b2741199.html (''The Independent'')]
*[[2025 Nushki oil tanker explosion]]
**Three firefighters are killed and 70 others are injured when a fuel tanker explodes in the [[Nushki District]], [[Balochistan, Pakistan|Balochistan]], [[Pakistan]]. The driver of the tanker were also killed in the incident. [https://www.dawn.com/news/1907142 (DAWN.COM)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[:zh:天津市天津醫院持刀傷人事件|Tianjin Hospital stabbing]]
**Two people are killed and four others are injured, including one seriously, in a [[mass stabbing]] attack at the [[Tianjin Hospital]] in [[Tianjin]], China. All the victims were medical staff, including Luo Wei, an orthopedic doctor and deputy chief physician of the Second Department of Sports Trauma Arthroscopy. [https://hk.on.cc/hk/bkn/cnt/news/20250501/bkn-20250501084137284-0501_00822_001.html (Oriental Daily News)]
*Six people are injured in a [[mass stabbing]] attack at a high school in [[Cheongju]], [[South Korea]]. The attacker, a student, is arrested. [https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10475204 (''The Korea Herald'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 Canadian federal election]]
**Voters in [[Canada]] go to the polls to elect the 343 [[Member of Parliament (Canada)|members]] of the [[House of Commons (Canada)|House of Commons]] to the 45th Canadian [[Parliament of Canada|Parliament]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c5ylzkzxkndo (BBC)]
**The [[Liberal Party of Canada|Liberal Party]] under leader [[Mark Carney]] is projected to form government for the party's fourth consecutive mandate, with Carney remaining [[Prime Minister of Canada|prime minister]]. [https://www.theglobeandmail.com/politics/article-liberals-projected-to-return-to-power-with-fourth-consecutive-mandate/ (''The Globe and Mail'')]
**[[Conservative Party of Canada|Conservative Party]] leader [[Pierre Poilievre]] and [[New Democratic Party]] leader [[Jagmeet Singh]] lose their seats, with the NDP also losing official party status in the House. Each make speeches conceding the election, with Singh announcing his intention to resign as party leader. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/federal-election-2025/article/ctv-news-declares-liberal-minority-singh-to-step-down-as-ndp-leader-live-updates-here/ (CTV News)]
*[[2025 papal conclave]]
**The [[Holy See|Vatican]] announces the 2025 [[papal conclave]] will take place starting on May 7 in the [[Sistine Chapel]] to elect [[Pope]] [[Pope Francis|Francis]]'s successor after his [[Death and funeral of Pope Francis|death]] on April 21. [https://www.npr.org/2025/04/28/g-s1-63087/conclave-next-pope-start-date (NPR)] [https://www.vaticannews.va/en/vatican-city/news/2025-04/conclave-elect-new-pope-cardinals-beginning-date-may-2025.html (''Vatican News'')]
* [[2025 Trinidad and Tobago general election]]
**Voters in [[Trinidad and Tobago]] go to the polls to elect the 41 members of the [[House of Representatives (Trinidad and Tobago)|House of Representatives]]. [https://radiojamaicanewsonline.com/regional/voting-underway-in-trinidad-tobagos-national-election (Radio Jamaica News)]
**The opposition [[United National Congress]], led by [[Kamla Persad-Bissessar]], wins a majority of seats. [https://jamaica-gleaner.com/article/news/20250428/unc-wins-tt-election-ruling-party-concedes-defeat (''The Gleaner'')]
